g.text: 1964-1989 | abundance relative to each age's 1964-2026 mean
Cells: abundance / age-specific mean (CV%); CV = asymptotic SE as a percentage of the estimate
Colour denominators: each age's arithmetic mean over 1964-2026 (all 63 years).
Labels: multiples to 1 decimal; CV to whole %. 1 = age mean; 2 = twice the mean.
10+ sums ages 10-14 and 15+ once; its SE retains all cross-age covariance.
